![Vaultwarden Logo](./resources/vaultwarden-logo-auto.svg) Bitwarden Client API의 대체 서버 구현으로, Rust로 작성되었으며 [공식 Bitwarden 클라이언트](https://bitwarden.com/download/)와 호환됩니다 [[면책 조항](#disclaimer)]. 공식 리소스 집약적 서비스를 실행하는 것이 적절치 않은 셀프호스팅 배포에 적합합니다. --- [![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/github/release/dani-garcia/vaultwarden.svg?style=for-the-badge&logo=vaultwarden&color=005AA4)](https://github.com/dani-garcia/vaultwarden/releases/latest) [![ghcr.io Pulls](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=fff&color=005AA4&url=https%3A%2F%2Fipitio.github.io%2Fbackage%2Fdani-garcia%2Fvaultwarden%2Fvaultwarden.json&query=%24.downloads&label=ghcr.io%20pulls&cacheSeconds=14400)](https://github.com/dani-garcia/vaultwarden/pkgs/container/vaultwarden) [![Docker Pulls](https://img.shields.io/docker/pulls/vaultwarden/server.svg?style=for-the-badge&logo=docker&logoColor=fff&color=005AA4&label=docker.io%20pulls)](https://hub.docker.com/r/vaultwarden/server) [![Quay.io](https://img.shields.io/badge/quay.io-download-005AA4?style=for-the-badge&logo=redhat&cacheSeconds=14400)](https://quay.io/repository/vaultwarden/server)

## 기능 Bitwarden Client API의 거의 완전한 구현을 제공합니다: * [개인 볼트(Personal Vault)](https://bitwarden.com/help/managing-items/) * [Send](https://bitwarden.com/help/about-send/) * [첨부 파일](https://bitwarden.com/help/attachments/) * [웹사이트 아이콘](https://bitwarden.com/help/website-icons/) * [개인 API 키](https://bitwarden.com/help/personal-api-key/) * [조직(Organizations)](https://bitwarden.com/help/getting-started-organizations/) - [Collections](https://bitwarden.com/help/about-collections/), [비밀번호 공유](https://bitwarden.com/help/sharing/), [멤버 역할](https://bitwarden.com/help/user-types-access-control/), [그룹](https://bitwarden.com/help/about-groups/), [이벤트 로그](https://bitwarden.com/help/event-logs/), [관리자 비밀번호 재설정](https://bitwarden.com/help/admin-reset/), [Directory Connector](https://bitwarden.com/help/directory-sync/), [정책(Policies)](https://bitwarden.com/help/policies/) * [다중/이중 인증(Multi/Two Factor Authentication)](https://bitwarden.com/help/bitwarden-field-guide-two-step-login/) - [Authenticator](https://bitwarden.com/help/setup-two-step-login-authenticator/), [Email](https://bitwarden.com/help/setup-two-step-login-email/), [FIDO2 WebAuthn](https://bitwarden.com/help/setup-two-step-login-fido/), [YubiKey](https://bitwarden.com/help/setup-two-step-login-yubikey/), [Duo](https://bitwarden.com/help/setup-two-step-login-duo/) * [비상 접근(Emergency Access)](https://bitwarden.com/help/emergency-access/) * [Vaultwarden Admin Backend](https://github.com/dani-garcia/vaultwarden/wiki/Enabling-admin-page) * [수정된 Web Vault 클라이언트](https://github.com/dani-garcia/bw_web_builds) (컨테이너에 번들됨)
## 사용법 > [!IMPORTANT] > web-vault에는 HTTPS와 [Web Crypto API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_Crypto_API)를 위한 secure context가 필요합니다.
> 즉 [HTTPS 활성화](https://github.com/dani-garcia/vaultwarden/wiki/Enabling-HTTPS) 시에만 작동합니다.
> [리버스 프록시](https://github.com/dani-garcia/vaultwarden/wiki/Proxy-examples) 사용도 권장합니다. Vaultwarden 설치·사용 권장 방식은 [ghcr.io](https://github.com/dani-garcia/vaultwarden/pkgs/container/vaultwarden), [docker.io](https://hub.docker.com/r/vaultwarden/server), [quay.io](https://quay.io/repository/vaultwarden/server)에 게시된 컨테이너 이미지입니다. 제공되는 태그에 대한 설명은 [어떤 컨테이너 이미지를 사용할지](https://github.com/dani-garcia/vaultwarden/wiki/Which-container-image-to-use)를 참조하세요. [커뮤니티 패키지](https://github.com/dani-garcia/vaultwarden/wiki/Third-party-packages)도 있지만, 최신 버전보다 늦거나 Vaultwarden 구성 방식이 다를 수 있습니다. 자세한 내용은 [Wiki](https://github.com/dani-garcia/vaultwarden/wiki)를 참조하세요. 또는 직접 [Vaultwarden 빌드](https://github.com/dani-garcia/vaultwarden/wiki/Building-binary)할 수도 있습니다. Vaultwarden은 TLS를 기본 지원하는 [Rocket 웹 프레임워크](https://rocket.rs) 기반이지만, 리버스 프록시 설정을 권장합니다([프록시 예제](https://github.com/dani-garcia/vaultwarden/wiki/Proxy-examples) 참조). > [!TIP] >**Vaultwarden 설치, 사용, 구성에 대한 더 자세한 예제는 [Wiki](https://github.com/dani-garcia/vaultwarden/wiki)에서 확인하세요.** ### Docker/Podman CLI 컨테이너 이미지를 pull하고 영구 저장소를 위해 호스트 볼륨을 마운트하세요.
podman을 선호하면 `docker`를 `podman`으로 바꿔도 됩니다. ```shell docker pull vaultwarden/server:latest docker run --detach --name vaultwarden \ --env DOMAIN="https://vw.domain.tld" \ --volume /vw-data/:/data/ \ --restart unless-stopped \ --publish 127.0.0.1:8000:80 \ vaultwarden/server:latest ``` 영구 데이터는 `/vw-data/` 아래 보존되며, 경로는 원하는 대로 조정 가능합니다. ### Docker Compose Docker compose를 사용하려면 Vaultwarden 컨테이너 실행 구성을 담는 `compose.yaml`을 생성해야 합니다. ```yaml services: ``` > *(이하 원문 참조)*
